text.en:
Subject to all the conditions, terms, restrictions and limitations of Act Numbered Thirty-four
hundred and ninety-five, as amended by Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and ninety-two, the Robert Dollar
Company, a corporation organized and existing under the laws of the State of California, United States of
America, is hereby authorized to sell, convey, assign or transfer its franchise and all rights and privileges
acquired by it under said Act to construct, maintain and operate in the Philippine Islands stations for the
transmission and reception of wireless messages unto the Globe Wireless, Limited, a corporation organized or
to be organized under the laws of the Philippine Islands, hereby approving the same.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 28, 1934.
